reason: 完整 HTML 全文（无独立附录）已读；证据薄但足以八项判定。

paper.central_claim: Online Repository Memory（对历史 commit 做 blind attempt→oracle diff 对比反思→CRUD 更新 skill 文档）能在同仓库严格时间切分的未来 PR 任务上提升 organicity（文件定位、补丁膨胀、LLM 判官的逻辑/冗余/风格），生成与维护者期望一致的贡献。作者原话：'Online Repository Memory effectively improves organicity scores on held-out future tasks'；结论称 'significantly improve file localisation, reduce patch bloat, and ... genuinely align with expert maintainers' expectations'。
paper.title: Learning to Commit: Generating Organic Pull Requests via Online Repository Memory

evidence.quote: show that Online Repository Memory effectively improves organicity scores on held-out future tasks
evidence.support_explanation: 作者中心主张及范围：单个专家维护仓库、未来任务。

evidence.quote: spans multiple dimensions including functional correctness, code-style consistency, internal API reuse rate, and modified-region plausibility
evidence.support_explanation: 摘要声明的评测维度；正文只报告 File IoU/steps/line deviation 与 LLM 判官 Q1-Q4，未单独报告功能正确性或 API 复用率。

evidence.quote: the agent updates the skill document through explicit CRUD operations—creating new entries for previously unknown patterns, revising entries that were partially correct, and deprecating entries contradicted by the oracle evidence
evidence.support_explanation: 留存对象与编辑操作：skill 文档，CRUD 含 deprecate；除此无其他接受/回退门控描述。

evidence.quote: No rigid retrieval pipeline or pre-planned workflow is imposed; the agent decides which skills to consult and which files to explore based on its own judgement
evidence.support_explanation: 后续读取方式：整份文档放入上下文，由 agent 自行决定是否使用，无检索/版本/命中记录。

evidence.quote: they rely on unsupervised self-reflection. Without explicit expert supervision, agents are prone to accumulating self-reinforcing errors.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者定位的残余问题：无监督自反思在时间序列任务上自强化错误；本文以 oracle diff 作为监督。

evidence.quote: Crucially, the strict temporal split ensures that all learning commits predate all test commits, completely preventing information leakage from evaluation tasks into the skill-building phase.
evidence.support_explanation: 时间切分：学习提交均早于测试提交；skill 构建阶段看不到测试任务。

evidence.quote: By design, our same-repository, time-split evaluation inherently guarantees zero data leakage.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者对预训练泄漏的断言；仓库为内部仓库，但文中无泄漏/重叠核查（our_inference：断言而非检验）。

evidence.quote: This yields 386 high-quality, substantive commits (a 77.2% suitability rate) distributed across seven core development categories
evidence.support_explanation: 数据管线分母：2738 → 386；LLM 判定 'substantive'。

evidence.quote: we perform stratified sampling to construct a balanced curriculum of 24 historical learning commits and 7 genuinely future, held-out test tasks
evidence.support_explanation: 学习集 24、测试集仅 7 个任务。

evidence.quote: a baseline agent (which operates without any skill document), both powered by Claude Opus 4.6 with identical tool-use capabilities
evidence.support_explanation: 对照：同模型同工具无 skill 文档（store-off）；agent 与判官之一同属 Claude Opus 4.6 家族。

File IoU / Steps / Line Dev（Skill/Base）。同一 7 任务的无 skill 基线在四行中 File IoU 为 61/68/72/71%、steps 为 71.9/62.7/68.3/76.4、line dev 1.59/0.88/1.06/1.13，说明基线单次运行噪声约 10pp，与最大增益 19pp（seq-all，基线最低）同量级（our_inference）。

evidence.quote: The skill-conditioned agent achieves consistently higher File IoU in three out of four settings, with the largest gain of +19 percentage points in seq-all (80% vs. 61%).
evidence.support_explanation: 作者对 File IoU 的主结果表述。

evidence.quote: Setting Claude Judge Gemini Judge par-bycat 54% 57% seq-all 55% 58% par-all 46% 54% seq-bycat 26% 46%
evidence.support_explanation: 整体成对胜率（skill agent 胜率，平局比例未给）；Claude 判官下仅两行 >50%，seq-bycat 仅 26%/46%。

evidence.quote: Q1: Scope Alignment 25% 41% 34% Q2: Logic Similarity 50% 25% 25% Q3: Redundancy & Halluc. 54% 41% 5% Q4: Code Style 27% 38% 36%
evidence.support_explanation: par-bycat 分维度：skill 在 Q2/Q3 占优，基线在 Q1(scope)与 Q4(code style)占优——与 'organic/风格一致' 的叙事相反。

evidence.quote: we run evaluations with two independent judge models and report agreement rates
evidence.support_explanation: 正文声明报告一致率，但材料中未出现具体一致率数值（负面事实，见 search_scope）。

evidence.quote: the skill agent retains a redundant defensive guard that the baseline omits, resulting in slightly more verbose code
evidence.support_explanation: 作者自报最大负面案例；仅给 1 正 1 负案例，无失败分母统计。

evidence.quote: significantly improve file localisation, reduce patch bloat
evidence.support_explanation: 结论用 'significantly'，但全文无显著性检验/置信区间。

evidence.quote: While we validate on an expert-maintained internal repository in this work
evidence.support_explanation: 唯一内部仓库；贡献条目中称 'construct and release' 基准，但评测仓库非公开（范围/可复现性限制）。

evidence.quote: relying on LLMs as evaluators inherently introduces potential biases and inaccuracies
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认 LLM 判官偏差，并将可验证指标列为 future work。
